sources.title: South Sudan travel advice and safety
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Australian Government destination page is directed to Australian travellers, was updated 22 May 2026, and tells them to obtain the visa through South Sudan's eVisa department before travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You won't be allowed to enter the country without one. Check Department of e-Visa and Immigration Services to get a visa.

sources.title: Emirates travel requirements — South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, United Arab Emirates
sources.officialityEvidence: The live UAE MOFA page was modified 9 July 2026, selects the normal passport, directs the applicant to South Sudan's eVisa issuer and states a 30-day stay.

sources.title: South Sudan eVisa: issuance steps
sources.publisher: South Sudan Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Interior eVisa service identifies the competent immigration department and says the approved electronic visa is downloaded before travel and presented at entry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: South Sudan eVisa
policies.summary: Current Australian Government guidance directs Australian travellers to South Sudan's eVisa department for a visa issued before travel, while the official issuer delivers an approved downloadable PDF.
conditions: Applies to an Australian visitor using an ordinary passport and travelling despite the Australian Government's do-not-travel advice.

Apply before travel through the South Sudan Department of E-Visa and Immigration Services. The issuer says an approved eVisa PDF can be downloaded within 72 hours; processing and approval are not guaranteed.

Carry the approved PDF for verification and passport stamping at the port of entry. Passport validity, yellow-fever certification, security restrictions, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

application.label: South Sudan eVisa service
application.processingTime: The official service says the downloadable PDF is available within 72 hours after approval.
steps: Create an account and complete the eVisa application before travel.
Pay the application fee and wait for a decision; approval is not guaranteed.
Download the approved PDF and present it with the passport at the port of entry.

policies.title: Emirati normal passports: South Sudan eVisa
policies.summary: The UAE Foreign Ministry's current South Sudan page directly selects the normal passport and directs UAE nationals to the official South Sudan eVisa issuer, which provides an approved downloadable PDF before travel.
conditions: Applies to UAE nationals using a normal passport; the UAE page includes tourism among the stated purposes and describes a 30-day stay beginning on the specified arrival date.
Apply before travel through the South Sudan eVisa service. The issuer says an approved eVisa PDF can be downloaded within 72 hours; processing and approval are not guaranteed.
Present the approved PDF for verification and passport stamping at the port of entry. Passport validity, purpose-specific documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

application.label: South Sudan eVisa service
application.processingTime: The official service says the downloadable PDF is available within 72 hours after approval.
steps: Create an account and complete the eVisa application using the UAE normal passport before travel.
Pay the application fee and wait for a decision; approval is not guaranteed.
Download the approved PDF and present it with the passport at the port of entry.
